title: fix(core): MessageBus.request() silently hangs 60s when publish() fails

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear description of a bug in MessageBus.request() where an unhandled publish rejection causes process crashes or silent 60-second timeouts. The root cause and fix location are well defined.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The bug fix is a localized single-file logic change in MessageBus.request() to attach a .catch() handler to the publish call and clean up timers, accompanied by unit tests in Vitest.

summary.problem: MessageBus.request() contains an unhandled floating promise for this.publish(), leading to silent 60-second timeouts or uncaught process crashes when publish() rejects.
summary.root_cause: In MessageBus.request(), this.publish({ ...request, correlationId }) is called without awaiting or chaining a .catch() handler to clean up and reject the request promise.
summary.context: Failing to handle rejection in request() leaves the response subscription active and waits for the full 60-second timeout before failing fast.

steps: Modify MessageBus.request() in packages/core/src/confirmation-bus/message-bus.ts to chain .catch() on the this.publish() call.
In the .catch() callback, call cleanup() to clear the request timeout and response listener, and reject the Promise with the caught error.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When publish() rejects during a request() call, the request promise immediately rejects with the publish error instead of timing out after 60 seconds.
verification_steps: Add a test case in packages/core/src/confirmation-bus/message-bus.test.ts that mocks publish() or triggers a publish failure during request(), and asserts that request() rejects fast with the expected error.
